How to read this

Every chapter carries the same running system: a public Orders API at Meridian Supply, a canonical order, an ERP, a SaaS CRM, an event stream, and a supplier who still sends EDI. Chapters 1–3 and 17–19 are deliberately short — the vendor-neutral ground is covered fast so the webMethods-specific chapters can go deep.
